# `⍟` — Natural log / Logarithm

`⍟Y`: ln Y. Pervasive.

```bpl
⍟1                ⍝ 0
```

`X⍟Y`: log<sub>X</sub> Y. Pervasive.

```bpl
2⍟8               ⍝ 3
10⍟100            ⍝ 2
```

Uses complex logarithms where needed. `⍟0` is `¯∞`, as IEEE 754 gives it. With base 1, the result is an infinity or NaN.
